dogecoin.text: When everything is going up even the dumbest trader will make money but it will go down surely and if you're still putting your money make sure that's not everything you have. It might only take a fraction to hit reality. #dogecoin #cryptocurrencies #sensibleinvesting

So, instead of waiting for Elon's speeches and memes taking Dogecoin to the moon, I'd  suggest you to stay away. 
If you're taking risk beware that it can go down like a whoosh 💨 because no circuit limit and no regulations. While there maybe upside, also beware of the downside

As rightly said by @Nithin0dha one should only take as much risk that they're capable to loose. Dogecoin shouldn't be considered as an investment- it's purely a gamble. Stocks have fundamentals, they have technicals, it's transparent and there's a basis on which the price rises

People follow herd mentality. They follow people with strong opinions and money. Recently few indian insta influencers have also started promoting dogecoin. It's definitely gonna go to the moon because more the hype = more the demand. But, I hope everyone knows it's a gamble.
